column1: # 英文版字典：每行「中文<TAB>英文」。中文是遊戲裡寫進畫面的片段，英文可以留空（等於把那段拿掉）。
# 改完執行 python build.py；python build.py --missing 會列出還沒翻的中文。
選一個存檔欄位開新局
column2: Pick a save slot for the new game

column1: ⚠ 遊戲出了點問題，點這裡回報
column2: ⚠ Something went wrong — tap here to report

column1: 🆕 有新版本，點這裡更新（會先存檔）
column2: 🆕 New version available — click to update (saves first)
📱↻ Turn your phone sideways to play

column1: 按 F4 隱藏介面・按 F5 存檔
column2: F4 hides the HUD · F5 saves

column1: 🖱 左鍵裝備・右鍵加到快捷欄
column2: 🖱 Left-click to equip · right-click to add to hotbar

column1: 🔒 已鎖定，點一下看科技樹
column2: 🔒 Locked — click to open the tech tree

column1: 點一下裝備，然後在地上點一下放好。
column2: Click to equip, then click the ground to place it.

column1: 極高畫質（電腦，很吃效能）
按鍵（點一下再按新的鍵）
column2: Keys (click, then press the new key)

column1: 請確認網路連線，再重新整理一次。加入主畫面的話，要先連網打開過一次才能離線玩。
column2: Check your internet connection and reload. If you added the game to your home screen, open it once while online before playing offline.

column1: 這個瀏覽器沒辦法顯示 3D 畫面（WebGL）。
請換成 Chrome、Edge 或 Safari，或到瀏覽器設定打開「硬體加速」再試一次。
column2: Try Chrome, Edge or Safari, or turn on "hardware acceleration" in your browser settings and try again.

column1: 給效能比較弱的電腦玩，找一元的時間比較短，硬幣堆旁邊也有空間可以走動。
column2: For slower computers. NT$1 coins are quicker to find, and there's room to walk around the pile.

column1: 高約 5 公尺，大約有 480 萬枚硬幣。
column2: About 5 m tall, roughly 4.8 million coins.

column1: 原本的院子，整個設計就是圍著這堆硬幣做的，上面蓋著一整片鋼屋頂。
column2: The original yard — everything is built around this pile, under a full steel roof.

column1: 高約 7 公尺，大約有 1380 萬枚硬幣。
column2: About 7 m tall, roughly 13.8 million coins.

column1: 硬幣多一倍，堆頂比牆還高，記得帶輸送帶來。
column2: Twice the coins; the top is higher than the walls. Bring conveyor belts.

column1: 高約 9 公尺，大約有 3400 萬枚硬幣。
column2: About 9 m tall, roughly 34 million coins.

column1: 八層樓高的硬幣，硬幣都往外擠出了，屋頂都蓋不住，載入比較慢。
column2: Eight stories of coins spilling out everywhere — the roof can't cover it and it loads slowly.

column1: 高約 11 公尺，大約有 3.2 億枚硬幣。
column2: About 11 m tall, roughly 320 million coins.

column1: 隱藏的第五種：一座 50 公尺高的硬幣山，屋頂完全蓋不住，硬幣要倒一分鐘才倒完。
column2: The hidden fifth size: a 50-meter coin mountain. No roof can cover it, and dumping it takes a whole minute.

column1: 高約 50 公尺，大約有 11 億枚硬幣。
column2: About 50 m tall, roughly 1.1 billion coins.

column1: 一把小鏟子，一次挖 18 枚。
column2: A little shovel that digs 18 coins at a time.
Forks up 82 coins at a time.

column1: 可以裝 2100 枚，推起來比較慢。
column2: Holds 2,100 coins, but it's slower to push.

column1: 把撒在地上的硬幣掃成一堆。
column2: Sweeps scattered coins into a pile.

column1: 偵測 1 元，越靠近嗶得越快。空曠的地方測得遠，隔著硬幣堆只測得到 1 公尺內。要先在科技樹解鎖。
column2: Detects NT$1 coins and beeps faster as you get closer. Reaches far in the open, but only 1 m through a coin pile. Unlock it in the tech tree first.

column1: 按住左鍵一直吸，可以裝 900 枚。要先在科技樹解鎖（V8 降價 80%）。
column2: Hold left-click to keep sucking; holds 900 coins. Unlock it in the tech tree first (V8 cuts the price by 80%).

column1: 拿在手上，綠圈裡的硬幣堆和地上的硬幣有沒有 1 元，一掃就知道。要先在科技樹解鎖。
column2: Hold it up and instantly see whether the coins inside the green circle — in the pile or on the ground — contain an NT$1 coin. Unlock it in the tech tree first.

column1: 雙手一次可以多抓 1 枚，最多一次抓 15 枚。
column2: Your hands grab 1 more coin at a time, up to 15.

column1: 五金行有賣。一次挖 18 枚。
column2: Sold at the hardware store. Digs 18 coins at a time.

column1: 五金行有賣。把地上的硬幣掃成一堆。
column2: Sold at the hardware store. Sweeps coins on the ground into a pile.

column1: 五金行有賣。可以裝 600 枚。
column2: Sold at the hardware store. Holds 600 coins.

column1: 五金行有賣。一次挖 54 枚。
column2: Sold at the hardware store. Digs 54 coins at a time.

column1: 五金行有賣。一次叉起 82 枚。
column2: Sold at the hardware store. Forks up 82 coins at a time.

column1: 五金行有賣。可以裝 2100 枚。
column2: Sold at the hardware store. Holds 2,100 coins.

column1: 玩具鏟一次多挖 3 枚。
column2: The toy shovel digs 3 more coins at a time.
The spade digs 12% more at a time.
The pitchfork forks 12% more at a time.

column1: 水桶和手推車倒硬幣快 12%。
解鎖之後，五金行就有賣金屬探測器（$390）。
column2: Once unlocked, the hardware store sells the metal detector ($390).

column1: 金屬探測器測得更遠。最高級：空曠的地方 11 公尺，隔著硬幣堆 1.8 公尺。
column2: The metal detector reaches farther. Max level: 11 m in the open, 1.8 m through the pile.

column1: 解鎖之後，五金行就有賣院子吸塵器（$90）。
column2: Once unlocked, the hardware store sells the yard vacuum ($90).

column1: 院子吸塵器多裝 500 枚。
column2: The yard vacuum holds 500 more coins.

column1: 每級跳高 5 公分，爬硬幣堆比較輕鬆。
column2: Each level jumps 5 cm higher, making the pile easier to climb.

column1: 鞋子抓得住輸送帶，站在跑動的輸送帶上不會被帶走，往哪個方向走都可以。
column2: Your boots grip moving belts, so they won't carry you away — you can walk any direction on them.

column1: 按住 C 蹲著走，手上的硬幣不會灑出來。每級蹲走快 5%。
column2: Hold C to crouch-walk without spilling coins. Each level crouch-walks 5% faster.
Spill 8% less when running with coins.

column1: 拿著硬幣跳起來落地時少灑 10%。
column2: Spill 10% less when landing from a jump with coins.

column1: 可以拿到遠 30 公分的硬幣。
可以把東西蓋到遠 50 公分的地方。
掃把一次掃更寬的範圍。
column2: The broom sweeps a wider area.

column1: 在空中按住空白鍵往上飛。滿油可以飛 10 秒，落地後大約 8 秒回滿。
column2: Hold Space in the air to fly up. A full tank lasts 10 seconds and refills in about 8 seconds on the ground.

column1: 解鎖輸送帶，按 B 就能蓋，每公尺 $8。點一下定起點，再點一下定終點。
column2: Unlocks conveyor belts — press B to build, $8 per meter. Click once for the start, again for the end.

column1: 所有輸送帶快 45%，蓋好的也一樣。一開始每秒 0.7 公尺。
column2: All belts move 45% faster, including ones already built. Base speed is 0.7 m/s.

column1: 解鎖合流器和 U 型合流器（$120）：兩條輸送帶合成一條。
column2: Unlocks the merger and U-merger ($120): joins two belts into one.

column1: 解鎖卸料口（$40）：滿滿一桶或一車硬幣對著它倒，就會倒到前面的輸送帶上。
column2: Unlocks the chute ($40): pour a full bucket or barrow into it and the coins drop onto the belt in front.

column1: 把一條輸送帶分成左右兩條，輪流送。
column2: Splits one belt into two, alternating left and right.

column1: 解鎖硬幣發電機（$160）和電線桿（$45）。發電機燒硬幣，一台 6kW，最多存 240 枚燃料；電線桿 6 公尺內的機器有電。
column2: Unlocks the coin generator ($160) and power pole ($45). Generators burn coins: 6 kW each, holding up to 240 coins of fuel. Machines within 6 m of a pole get power.

column1: 所有硬幣發電機多 2kW，燃料多存 240 枚。還是要有足夠的燃料才發得出來。
column2: Every coin generator gets 2 kW more and stores 240 more coins of fuel. They still need enough fuel to produce it.

column1: 電線桿之間可以多拉 1.5 公尺（一開始 9 公尺）。
column2: Power poles can be 1.5 m farther apart (starts at 9 m).

column1: 解鎖地下電纜箱（$300）。跟電線桿一樣但走地下，可以連到 18 公尺外，10 公尺內的機器有電。
column2: Unlocks the underground cable box ($300). Works like a pole but runs underground: links up to 18 m and powers machines within 10 m.

column1: 解鎖開關箱（$350，一個院子一個）。替機器貼 8 種標籤，同一個標籤一起開關、改名、設優先。
column2: Unlocks the switch box ($350, one per yard). Tag machines with 8 labels to switch, rename and prioritize them together.

column1: 電線桿多供電 1 公尺範圍（一開始 6 公尺）。
column2: Power poles cover 1 m more (starts at 6 m).

column1: 所有活塞耙多了「前進」和「後退」。前面挖空了會自己往硬幣堆挪近一點，前面有東西擋住會自己停下來。
column2: All piston rakes get "forward" and "back". When the front is dug out they inch toward the pile, and stop if something's in the way.

column1: 第一級：每耙一次從 35 枚變 50 枚，耗電從 2kW 變 4kW。之後每級多耙 25%。
column2: Level 1: each rake pulls 50 coins instead of 35, and power goes from 2 kW to 4 kW. Each level after adds 25%.

column1: 機械手臂會從硬幣堆抓硬幣，放到旁邊的輸送帶上。一支 $100 起，每多一支更貴，最多 48 支。
column2: Robot arms grab coins from the pile and put them on a nearby belt. From $100 each, pricier with every extra arm, up to 48.

column1: 所有機械手臂一次多抓 8%。
column2: All robot arms grab 8% more at a time.

column1: 看著機械手臂按 E 可以設定：從後面的輸送帶拿東西，放到前面的輸送帶上。勾選種類，手臂就會把那種東西從輸送帶上挑出來。
column2: Look at a robot arm and press E to set it to take from the belt behind and put onto the belt in front. Tick item types and the arm picks those off the belt.

column1: 手臂可以設成平常不碰輸送帶，只有輸送帶塞住的時候才拿。
column2: Arms can be set to leave the belt alone unless it backs up.

column1: 設定手臂先拿什麼：散硬幣、最大的、或最近的。有 1 元的一定先拿。
column2: Choose what an arm takes first: loose coins, the biggest, or the nearest. Anything with an NT$1 coin always goes first.

column1: 雙手可以多拿一個加工品（硬幣捆、環保磚…）。一開始可以拿一個，按 E 放下最上面那個。
column2: Your hands can carry one more processed item (coin rolls, eco bricks…). You start with one; press E to put down the top one.

column1: 放料點可以多設遠 3.6 公尺（一開始 12 公尺）。
column2: Drop points can be 3.6 m farther away (starts at 12 m).

column1: 無人機也會把停機坪附近地上的加工品（硬幣捆、環保磚…）撿起來，送到放料點。
column2: Drones also pick up processed items (coin rolls, eco bricks…) lying near their pad and carry them to the drop point.

column1: 每台分流器多一個優先設定（看著它按 E）：選定的那一邊拿全部，塞住了才分給另一邊。
column2: Every splitter gets a priority setting (look at it and press E): the chosen side gets everything, and only overflow goes to the other side.

column1: 會看接上的輸送帶自己設定：一條進來就分成兩條，兩條進來就合成一條。一個 $120。
column2: Sets itself up from the belts attached: one in splits into two, two in merge into one. $120 each.

column1: 夾在輸送帶上，按 E 拉桿可以擋住硬幣，再拉一次放行。一個 $60。
column2: Clamps onto a belt. Press E to pull the lever and stop coins; pull again to let them through. $60 each.

column1: 每公尺 $12。東西藏在裡面看不到，大工廠比較不卡；水桶和工具伸不進去。
column2: $12 per meter. Items are hidden inside, which keeps big factories smoother; buckets and tools can't reach in.

column1: 三條輸送帶輪流合成一條。一個 $450。
column2: Merges three belts into one in turn. $450 each.

column1: 每台造粒機的出料口可以往左或往右轉（看著它按 E），決定環保磚掉在哪裡。
column2: Every pelletizer's outlet can turn left or right (look at it and press E) to choose where eco bricks drop.

column1: 筒倉每分鐘最多多放 20 批。
column2: Silos release up to 20 more batches per minute.

column1: 筒倉每一批多放 25% 的散硬幣。
column2: Each silo batch releases 25% more loose coins.

column1: 每塊環保磚多 25% 的硬幣，更值錢，燒得也更久。圓盤壓製機還是吃 2 塊。
column2: Each eco brick holds 25% more coins: worth more and burns longer. Disc presses still take 2.

column1: 每片紙漿板多 25% 的硬幣，更值錢，用水不變。
column2: Each pulp board holds 25% more coins and is worth more, using the same water.

column1: 院子吸塵器吸得快 25%，範圍也更大。
column2: The yard vacuum sucks 25% faster over a wider area.

column1: 把 60 枚散硬幣壓成一捆，硬幣捆賣價是散硬幣的 2 倍。訂單要用。
column2: Presses 60 loose coins into a roll worth twice as much. Orders need them.

column1: 硬幣捆和包裝硬幣捆多賣 7%。
column2: Coin rolls and wrapped rolls sell for 7% more.

column1: 把散硬幣直接做成環保硬幣磚，賣價是散硬幣的 2.5 倍。
column2: Turns loose coins straight into eco coin bricks, worth 2.5× loose coins.
Eco coin bricks sell for 7% more.

column1: 用兩條輸送帶把散硬幣和環保硬幣磚送進去，壓成硬幣圓盤，賣價是散硬幣的 4.2 倍。
column2: Feed in loose coins and eco bricks on two belts to press coin discs, worth 4.2× loose coins.

column1: 用硬幣和水做紙漿板。要接水管。
column2: Makes pulp boards from coins and water. Needs a water pipe.

column1: 三片紙漿板做成一捲紙。要接水管。
column2: Turns three pulp boards into a roll of paper. Needs a water pipe.

column1: 先把硬幣存起來，再照設定的速度每分鐘放出來。筒倉裡的硬幣也可能藏著 1 元，放出來要先掃描。
column2: Stores coins and releases them at a set rate per minute. Coins in a silo may still hide NT$1 coins, so scan them on the way out.

column1: 一座 20kW，燒環保硬幣磚，還要接水管（每秒 2 公升）。
column2: 20 kW each. Burns eco coin bricks and needs a water pipe (2 L/s).

column1: 燃氣發電廠多 25% 電，要用更多環保磚和水。
column2: Gas plants make 25% more power but use more bricks and water.

column1: 抽地下水，用水管接到要用水的機器。解鎖之後也可以蓋水管、三通和接頭。
column2: Pumps groundwater; pipe it to machines that need water. Also unlocks pipes, tees and crosses.

column1: 抽水機多抽 25% 的水，不多耗電。
column2: Pumps deliver 25% more water with no extra power.

column1: 掃描器 Mk I 藍圖
放在輸送帶上，把混在硬幣裡的 1 元收進抽屜。一台每分鐘掃 1,000 枚，太多會漏掉。抽屜滿了輸送帶就會停住，要走過去按 E 拿出來。
column2: Sits on a belt and drops NT$1 coins mixed in with the others into its drawer. Scans 1,000 coins a minute; more than that slips by. When the drawer is full the belt stops — walk over and press E to empty it.

column1: 掃描器 Mk II 藍圖
每分鐘掃 1,667 枚，抽屜大一倍。抽屜滿了會把 1 元放到旁邊的托盤，輸送帶不會停。
column2: Scans 1,667 coins a minute with a drawer twice as big. When full it puts NT$1 coins on a tray beside it, so the belt keeps moving.
All scanners scan 25% more at a time.

column1: 掃描器的抽屜多放 4 枚 1 元（Mk I 一開始 4 枚）。
column2: Scanner drawers hold 4 more NT$1 coins (Mk I starts at 4).

column1: 解鎖之後五金行就有賣（$600）。綠圈裡有 1 元會直接標出來。
column2: Once unlocked, the hardware store sells it ($600). NT$1 coins inside the green circle are marked right away.

column1: 拿著金屬探測器按左鍵切換精準模式：靠近 1 元時嗶得快很多，但測得到的範圍不會變大。
column2: Left-click while holding the metal detector to toggle precision mode: it beeps much faster near an NT$1 coin, though the range stays the same.

column1: 衛星天線 Mk I 藍圖
解鎖衛星天線（$1,200，一個院子一個）。掃描 45 公尺內的硬幣堆，把埋在裡面的 1 元標出來。Mk I 每 60 秒標一枚。
column2: Unlocks the satellite dish ($1,200, one per yard). Scans the pile within 45 m and marks buried NT$1 coins. Mk I marks one every 60 seconds.

column1: 衛星天線 Mk II 藍圖
衛星天線每 30 秒標一枚。
column2: The dish marks one every 30 seconds.

column1: 衛星天線 Mk III 藍圖
衛星天線每 15 秒標兩枚。
column2: The dish marks two every 15 seconds.

column1: 衛星天線 Mk IV 藍圖
衛星天線每 8 秒標四枚。
column2: The dish marks four every 8 seconds.

column1: 大型偵測機，每分鐘掃 6,000 枚，挑出來的 1 元直接收進機器裡。
column2: A large detector that scans 6,000 coins a minute and keeps the NT$1 coins it finds inside.

column1: 可以伸到 3.5 公尺外，一次抓 80 枚。一支 $350 起。
column2: Reaches 3.5 m and grabs 80 coins at a time. From $350 each.

column1: 可以伸到 4.3 公尺外，一次抓 120 枚。一支 $600 起。
column2: Reaches 4.3 m and grabs 120 coins at a time. From $600 each.

column1: 無人機會自己在取料點和放料點之間搬硬幣，不用輸送帶。放料點最遠 12 公尺。一架 $200 起，每多一架貴 1.45 倍，最多 12 架。
column2: Drones ferry coins between a pickup and a drop point on their own — no belts needed. Drop points up to 12 m away. From $200 each, 1.45× pricier per extra drone, up to 12.

column1: 一條分成三條：直走、左、右輪流送。
column2: Splits one belt into three, taking turns: straight, left, right.

column1: 會看東西分路：有 1 元的往右、加工品往左、硬幣直走。
column2: Sorts by contents: NT$1 coins go right, processed items left, coins straight.

column1: 把東西往前射到 2～8 公尺外的輸送帶上，可以跳過擋路的東西。
column2: Shoots items forward onto a belt 2–8 m away, hopping over anything in the way.

column1: 解鎖硬幣升降機（$480）：把東西往上抬一層。建造時按 PageUp／PageDown 可以把輸送帶架高。
column2: Unlocks the coin lift ($480): raises items one level. Press PageUp/PageDown while building to raise belts.

column1: 解鎖硬幣階梯（$150）：不用電的階梯式輸送帶，把東西往上送一層。
column2: Unlocks coin stairs ($150): an unpowered stepped belt that carries items up one level.

column1: 解鎖平台，每平方公尺 $10，點兩個角。你和機器都可以站在上面。用 PageUp／PageDown 調高度。
column2: Unlocks platforms, $10 per square meter — click two corners. You and machines can stand on them. Use PageUp/PageDown to change the height.

column1: 解鎖樓梯（每公尺高 $15）和欄杆（每公尺 $6，高 1.05 公尺）。
column2: Unlocks stairs ($15 per meter of height) and railings ($6 per meter, 1.05 m tall).

column1: 解鎖牆、窗牆和門口，每公尺 $22，高 2.4 公尺。
column2: Unlocks walls, window walls and doorways: $22 per meter, 2.4 m tall.

column1: 解鎖平屋頂、斜屋頂和屋頂天窗，每公尺 $28。從天窗的梯子爬上屋頂。
column2: Unlocks flat roofs, sloped roofs and roof hatches, $28 per meter. Climb onto the roof by the hatch ladder.

column1: 解鎖油漆板（$35）。看著它按左鍵畫畫，右鍵擦掉。
column2: Unlocks the paint board ($35). Look at it and left-click to draw, right-click to erase.

column1: 輸送帶、平台、樓梯、欄杆、牆、屋頂每級便宜 5%，機器還是原價。
column2: Belts, platforms, stairs, railings, walls and roofs get 5% cheaper per level; machines stay full price.

column1: 把地上散落的硬幣推上輸送帶。
column2: Pushes coins scattered on the ground onto a belt.

column1: 只包硬幣捆，要接在壓縮機後面。包裝硬幣捆的賣價是硬幣捆的 1.45 倍。一台 $300。
column2: Wraps coin rolls only, so place it after a compactor. Wrapped rolls sell for 1.45× a roll. $300 each.

column1: 丟在地上的硬幣少掉 10%（一開始會掉 30%）。
column2: 10% fewer coins lost when dropped on the ground (starts at 30%).

column1: 每升一級，棚子往西邊多 5 公尺。
column2: Each level extends the shed 5 m to the west.

column1: 對準硬幣堆，每次耙 35 枚丟到後面的輸送帶上，每分鐘大約 780 枚。後面要保持淨空。
column2: Aim it at the pile: each stroke rakes 35 coins onto the belt behind it, about 780 a minute. Keep the back clear.

column1: 伸到 2.7 公尺外抓硬幣，放到箭頭方向的輸送帶上。每多一支更貴，所有手臂加起來最多 48 支。
column2: Reaches 2.7 m to grab coins and drops them on the belt in the arrow's direction. Each extra arm costs more; 48 arms max in total.

column1: 伸到 3.5 公尺外，一次抓 80 枚。每多一支更貴。
column2: Reaches 3.5 m and grabs 80 coins at a time. Each extra arm costs more.

column1: 伸到 4.3 公尺外，一次抓 120 枚。每多一支更貴。
column2: Reaches 4.3 m and grabs 120 coins at a time. Each extra arm costs more.

column1: 放在硬幣堆旁邊當停機坪，再點一下設定 12 公尺內的放料點（輸送帶、卸料口或收購站），無人機會自己來回搬。每多一架貴 1.45 倍，最多 12 架。
column2: Place it next to the pile as a landing pad, then click again to set a drop point within 12 m (a belt, chute or the buyer). The drone shuttles back and forth by itself. 1.45× pricier per extra drone, up to 12.

column1: 每公尺 $8。點一下定起點，再點一下定終點。
column2: $8 per meter. Click once for the start, again for the end.

column1: 東西進來之後輪流往左、往右送。
column2: Sends incoming items left and right in turn.
Sends items forward and right in turn.

column1: 有 1 元的往右、加工品往左、硬幣直走。
column2: NT$1 coins go right, processed items left, coins straight.

column1: 讓兩旁的輸送帶接進來，合成一條往箭頭方向走。
column2: Belts join from both sides and merge into one heading the arrow's way.

column1: 讓後面和旁邊的輸送帶接進來，合成一條。
column2: Belts join from behind and the side and merge into one.

column1: 會看接上的輸送帶自己設定：一條進來就輪流分給其他接著的輸送帶，兩條進來就合成一條。
column2: Sets itself up from the belts attached: one in is shared among the others, two in merge into one.

column1: 夾在輸送帶上。看著它按 E 拉桿：擋住硬幣，再拉一次放行。
column2: Clamps onto a belt. Look at it and press E to pull the lever: stops coins, pull again to let them through.

column1: 每公尺 $12。東西藏在裡面看不到，水桶和工具伸不進去。
column2: $12 per meter. Items are hidden inside; buckets and tools can't reach in.

column1: 左、右、後面三條輸送帶輪流合成一條，往箭頭方向走。
column2: Merges the left, right and back belts in turn into one heading the arrow's way.

column1: 對著它按右鍵丟硬幣，硬幣會掉到箭頭方向的輸送帶上。無人機也可以放料在這裡。
column2: Right-click to throw coins at it and they drop onto the belt in the arrow's direction. Drones can drop here too.

column1: 把東西往前射到 2～8 公尺外的輸送帶上。
column2: Shoots items forward onto a belt 2–8 m away.

column1: 把東西往上抬一層（1.5 公尺），放到前面那一格（架高的輸送帶或平台上的機器）。架高輸送帶的尾端沒接東西，東西就會往下掉。
column2: Lifts items up one level (1.5 m) onto the tile in front (a raised belt or a machine on a platform). If a raised belt ends with nothing attached, items fall off.

column1: 階梯式的輸送帶，不用電，把東西往上送一層到前面那一格。
column2: A stepped, unpowered belt that carries items up one level to the tile in front.

column1: 把前面 2.5 公尺內地上的硬幣推上後面的輸送帶。
column2: Pushes coins on the ground within 2.5 m in front onto the belt behind.

column1: 每 60 枚散硬幣壓成一捆，從箭頭方向送出。硬幣捆賣價是散硬幣的 2 倍。
column2: Presses every 60 loose coins into a roll and sends it out the arrow side. A roll sells for twice the loose coins.

column1: 把硬幣捆拆回散的硬幣。
column2: Breaks coin rolls back into loose coins.

column1: 只包硬幣捆，接在壓縮機後面。包裝硬幣捆賣 1.45 倍。
column2: Wraps coin rolls only; place it after a compactor. Wrapped rolls sell for 1.45×.

column1: 每 100 枚散硬幣做成一塊環保硬幣磚，賣價是散硬幣的 2.5 倍。
column2: Turns every 100 loose coins into an eco coin brick worth 2.5× the loose coins.

column1: 從兩條輸送帶送進散硬幣和環保硬幣磚（50 枚硬幣＋2 塊磚），壓成硬幣圓盤，賣價 4.2 倍。
column2: Feed loose coins and eco bricks in on two belts (50 coins + 2 bricks) to press a coin disc worth 4.2×.

column1: 每 80 枚硬幣加水做成一片紙漿板。要用水管接到抽水機（每秒 2 公升）。
column2: Makes a pulp board from every 80 coins plus water. Pipe it to a pump (2 L/s).

column1: 三片紙漿板做成一捲紙。要用水管接到抽水機（每秒 3 公升）。
column2: Turns three pulp boards into a roll of paper. Pipe it to a pump (3 L/s).

column1: 最多存 20,000 枚硬幣，照設定的速度從箭頭方向放出來。看著它按 E 調整每分鐘放多少。
column2: Stores up to 20,000 coins and releases them out the arrow side at a set rate. Look at it and press E to set how many per minute.

column1: 一座 20kW，燒環保硬幣磚（一塊大約燒 30 秒），還要用水管接到抽水機（每秒 2 公升）。用輸送帶送磚進去，或拿著磚對它按右鍵。
column2: 20 kW each. Burns eco coin bricks (about 30 s each) and needs a pipe to a pump (2 L/s). Feed bricks in by belt, or right-click it while holding a brick.

column1: 每秒抽 5 公升地下水。用水管接到要用水的機器。
column2: Pumps 5 L of groundwater per second. Pipe it to machines that need water.

column1: 每公尺 $14。點一下定起點，再點一下定終點。水管兩端的法蘭要對到機器或別的水管。
column2: $14 per meter. Click once for the start, again for the end. Each end's flange must meet a machine or another pipe.

column1: T 字形的水管接頭，三個口都可以進水或出水。R 旋轉。
column2: A T-shaped pipe fitting; all three openings can take water in or out. R rotates.

column1: 十字形的水管接頭，四個口都可以進水或出水。
column2: A cross-shaped pipe fitting; all four openings can take water in or out.

column1: 一台 6kW，燒硬幣發電，最多存 240 枚燃料（蓋好時是滿的）。對著它按右鍵丟硬幣，或用輸送帶送硬幣進去加燃料。3 公尺內的機器直接有電，遠一點的要用電線桿接過去。
column2: 6 kW each, burning coins for power, storing up to 240 coins of fuel (full when built). Right-click to throw coins in, or feed it by belt. Machines within 3 m get power directly; farther ones need a power pole.

column1: 跟電線桿一樣，但是電纜走地下，牆擋不住。可以連到 18 公尺外的電線桿、電纜箱或發電機，10 公尺內的機器有電。
column2: Like a power pole, but the cable runs underground so walls don't block it. Links to poles, cable boxes or generators up to 18 m away and powers machines within 10 m.

column1: 一個院子只能有一個。看著有電的機器按 E 可以貼上 8 種標籤之一，再到開關箱把同一個標籤的機器一起開或關。標籤設成「優先」，電不夠的時候先給它電。
column2: Only one per yard. Look at a powered machine and press E to give it one of 8 labels, then switch every machine with that label on or off here. Set a label to "priority" to power it first when power runs short.

column1: 自動拉電纜接到 9 公尺內的電線桿和發電機，6 公尺內的機器就有電。看著它按 E 可以關掉整條線路。
column2: Automatically runs cables to poles and generators within 9 m, powering machines within 6 m. Look at it and press E to switch off the whole line.

column1: 每平方公尺 $10，點兩個角。你和機器都可以站在上面。PageUp／PageDown 調高度（1.5／3／4.5 公尺）。
column2: $10 per square meter — click two corners. You and machines can stand on it. PageUp/PageDown sets the height (1.5/3/4.5 m).

column1: 每公尺高 $15。先點平台的邊，再點地上要落腳的地方（要在同一直線上）。
column2: $15 per meter of height. Click the platform edge first, then where it lands on the ground (in a straight line).

column1: 每公尺 $6，高 1.05 公尺。沿著平台的邊點兩下，擋住不會掉下去。
column2: $6 per meter, 1.05 m tall. Click twice along a platform edge to keep from falling off.

column1: 每公尺 $22，高 2.4 公尺的鋼牆。點兩下拉一道牆。
column2: $22 per meter: a 2.4 m steel wall. Click twice to draw a wall.

column1: 每公尺 $22。下面有 1.3 公尺高的開口，硬幣、輸送帶和人都過得去。
column2: $22 per meter, with a 1.3 m opening at the bottom that coins, belts and people can pass through.

column1: 每公尺 $22，1.1 公尺寬的門口，人可以走過去。
column2: $22 per meter: a 1.1 m wide doorway you can walk through.

column1: 每公尺 $28。沿著牆頂點兩下，往箭頭方向蓋進去 2 公尺。可以站在上面。
column2: $28 per meter. Click twice along a wall top to build 2 m in the arrow's direction. You can stand on it.

column1: 每公尺 $28。往箭頭方向升高 1 公尺的斜屋頂。
column2: $28 per meter: a roof rising 1 m toward the arrow.

column1: 每公尺 $28。中間有 0.9 公尺的洞和梯子，站在梯子旁邊按 E 爬上爬下。
column2: $28 per meter, with a 0.9 m hole and ladder in the middle. Stand by the ladder and press E to climb up or down.

column1: 立在地上的工作燈，照亮附近。
column2: A floor-standing work light that brightens the area.

column1: 一塊白板。看著它按左鍵畫畫，按右鍵擦掉。
column2: A whiteboard. Look at it and left-click to draw, right-click to erase.

column1: 把找到的 1 元放進來，會加成。
column2: Put the NT$1 coins you find in here for bonuses.

column1: 綠油油的盆栽，擺在院子裡看了心情好。
column2: A lush green plant that brightens up the yard.

column1: 一格小花圃，種滿五顏六色的花。矮矮的，可以踩上去。
column2: A small bed full of colorful flowers. It's low enough to step on.

column1: 木頭長椅。走過去按 E 坐下來休息，體力回得比較快。
column2: A wooden bench. Walk up and press E to sit and rest — stamina comes back faster.

column1: 掛在木柱上的紅燈籠，天黑之後會亮起來。
column2: A red lantern hanging on a wooden post. It lights up after dark.

column1: 一直招手的招財貓，希望 1 元自己跑出來。
column2: A beckoning lucky cat, hoping the NT$1 coins will come out on their own.

column1: 檢查經過的硬幣，發現 1 元就收進抽屜。每分鐘 1,000 枚。抽屜滿了輸送帶會停住，走過去按 E 拿出 1 元。
column2: Checks passing coins and drops any NT$1 coin into its drawer. 1,000 coins a minute. When the drawer is full the belt stops — walk over and press E to take them out.

column1: 每分鐘 1,667 枚，抽屜大一倍。抽屜滿了會把 1 元放到旁邊的托盤，輸送帶不會停。
column2: 1,667 coins a minute with a drawer twice as big. When full it puts NT$1 coins on a tray beside it so the belt keeps moving.

column1: 一個院子一個。掃描 45 公尺內的硬幣堆，把埋在裡面的 1 元用紅色記號標出來。Mk 等級越高標得越快。
column2: One per yard. Scans the pile within 45 m and marks buried NT$1 coins in red. Higher Mk levels mark faster.

column1: 大型偵測機，每分鐘掃 6,000 枚，挑出的 1 元收在機器裡，按 E 拿出來。
column2: A large detector that scans 6,000 coins a minute and keeps the NT$1 coins it finds inside — press E to take them out.
All belts in the yard 6% faster

column1: 建造目錄裡的東西都便宜 8%
column2: Everything in the build catalog 8% cheaper

column1: 可以把東西蓋到遠 20% 的地方

column2: All machines in the yard 10% faster

column1: 活塞耙、機械手臂、無人機快 15%
column2: Piston rakes, robot arms and drones 15% faster

column1: 掃描器的抽屜多放一倍
column2: Scanner drawers hold twice as much
Scanners scan 25% more at a time

column1: 挖硬幣時，遠 50% 的 1 元也會被挖出來
column2: When digging, NT$1 coins 50% farther away get dug out too

column1: 整個院子賺得多、跑得快 15%
column2: The whole yard earns and runs 15% more
All belts in the yard 15% faster
All belts in the yard 25% faster

column1: 被壓過、夾過的硬幣會凹，市面上很常見，收藏價值不高，但很有生活感。
column2: Coins get dented when they're run over or pinched. Very common and not worth much to collectors, but full of everyday life.

column1: 流通很多年、在口袋和收銀機裡磨來磨去，花紋和字都磨淡了。
column2: Years in pockets and cash registers have worn the design and lettering faint.

column1: 剛從銀行換出來的新硬幣，表面還亮晶晶的，沒什麼刮痕。
column2: A fresh coin straight from the bank, still shiny with hardly a scratch.

column1: 表面有一道一道刮痕，大概是跟鑰匙放在同一個口袋。
column2: Covered in scratches — it probably shared a pocket with someone's keys.

column1: 舊版的硬幣，跟現在的長得有點不一樣，阿公阿嬤的撲滿裡比較找得到。
column2: An older design that looks a little different from today's. You're more likely to find these in a grandparent's piggy bank.

column1: 銅放久了會氧化，長出一層綠綠的「銅綠」，跟古銅像上的綠色是同一種東西。
column2: Copper left for a long time oxidizes into green verdigris — the same green you see on old bronze statues.

column1: 銅的比例看起來特別高，顏色偏紅，在陽光下很好認。
column2: It looks extra copper-rich, with a reddish tint that's easy to spot in the sun.

column1: 梅花是很常出現在台灣錢幣上的圖案，這枚的梅花特別清楚。
column2: Plum blossoms often appear on Taiwanese coins, and this one's are especially crisp.

column1: 被火燒過或高溫烤過，顏色變得又黑又暗。
column2: Burnt or baked at high heat, it's turned dark and black.

column1: 中間被打了一個洞，有人會把硬幣穿洞當作吊飾或護身符。
column2: Someone punched a hole in the middle — some people wear holed coins as charms.

column1: 表面氧化成黑亮的顏色，像一面小小的黑鏡子。
column2: Its surface has oxidized to a glossy black, like a tiny black mirror.

column1: 兩面都是同一面的硬幣，很多是做來玩魔術的道具，真的鑄錯的非常稀有。
column2: Both sides show the same face. Most are magic-trick props; genuine mint errors are extremely rare.

column1: 顏色特別純、特別亮，像剛熔好的銅。
column2: An unusually pure, bright color, like freshly melted copper.

column1: 早年的一圓硬幣，流通到現在的很少，收藏家會特別留意年份。
column2: An early one-yuan coin. Few are still in circulation, and collectors watch for the year.

column1: 精鑄幣是用特別處理過的模具鑄的，表面像鏡子一樣亮，通常放在盒子裡不拿來用。
column2: Proof coins are struck with specially treated dies and shine like mirrors. They usually stay in their boxes.

column1: 從來沒被拿出去用過的「未流通」硬幣，邊緣沒有磨損，收藏家最愛。
column2: An "uncirculated" coin that's never been spent — no wear on the rim. Collectors love them.

column1: 鑄造時硬幣沒對準模具，圖案偏到一邊，這種「偏打」錯版很少見。
column2: The coin wasn't lined up with the die, so the design sits off to one side. Off-center errors are rare.

column1: 被封在透明膜裡保護起來的硬幣，通常是收藏家整理好的。
column2: Sealed in clear film for protection, usually by a collector.

column1: 一般的 1 元不會被磁鐵吸住，這枚卻會，不知道是哪裡混進了鐵。
column2: Normal NT$1 coins don't stick to magnets, but this one does. Somehow iron got mixed in.

column1: 有些年份鑄得特別少，同樣是 1 元，那幾年的就比較難找。
column2: Some years had very small mintages, so those NT$1 coins are harder to find.

column1: 鑄造時模具轉了一個角度，正面和背面的方向對不上，叫做「轉向錯版」。
column2: The die was rotated during striking, so the front and back don't line up — a "rotated die" error.

column1: 顏色金黃得不像話，像是被鍍上一層金。到底是誰做的？
column2: An absurdly golden color, as if it's been gold-plated. Who made this?

column1: 正式發行前，造幣廠會先鑄一些「試鑄幣」來測試，數量很少。
column2: Before official release, the mint strikes a few "pattern" coins for testing. Very few exist.

column1: 為了紀念特別的事情發行的硬幣，圖案跟平常的不一樣。
column2: Issued to commemorate a special occasion, with a design unlike the usual ones.

column1: 按住 Shift 可以跑，左下的黃條是體力。挖硬幣也會耗體力。
column2: Hold Shift to run. The yellow bar at the bottom left is stamina; digging uses it too.

column1: 拿著硬幣跑步會灑出來，按住 C 蹲著走就不會。
column2: Running with coins spills them. Hold C to crouch-walk and you won't.

column1: 按 Tab 打開科技樹。
column2: Press Tab to open the tech tree.

column1: 按 B 打開建造目錄。
column2: Press B to open the build catalog.

column1: 建造時按 R 旋轉，按 X 切換拆除（全額退費）。
column2: While building, R rotates and X toggles remove mode (full refund).

column1: 按 F4 可以隱藏介面，再按一次就會回來。
column2: F4 hides the HUD; press it again to bring it back.
Press F5 to save right away.

column1: 一直賣硬幣會有連擊，連擊越高賣越多。
column2: Selling coins back to back builds a combo — the higher the combo, the more you get.

column1: 收購站前面一定要放掃描器，不然 1 元會跟著被賣掉。
column2: Always put a scanner before the buyer, or NT$1 coins get sold along with the rest.

column1: 機器要有電才會動。硬幣發電機一台 6kW，要丟硬幣進去當燃料。
column2: Machines need power to run. A coin generator makes 6 kW and burns coins as fuel.

column1: 掃描器 Mk I 的抽屜滿了，整條輸送帶都會停住。
column2: When a Scanner Mk I drawer fills up, the whole belt stops.

column1: 活塞耙要對準硬幣堆，箭頭朝輸送帶。
column2: Aim the piston rake at the pile, with the arrow pointing at the belt.

column1: 丟在地上的硬幣會少掉一些，用掃把掃成一堆再撿。
column2: Some coins get lost when dropped on the ground. Sweep them into a pile with the broom before picking them up.

column1: 訂單板在鐵捲門旁邊的牆上，按 E 釘選訂單。
column2: The order board is on the wall by the roller door. Press E to pin an order.

column1: 這個瀏覽器不支援 WebGL。
把做好的東西全部賣掉

column2: Drop the coins in your hands first

column1: 發現了一枚 1 元！拿去一元收藏櫃放好
column2: found an NT$1 coin! Take it to the NT$1 collection cabinet

column1: 撿起一枚 1 元，拿去一元收藏櫃放好
column2: Picked up an NT$1 coin — take it to the NT$1 collection cabinet

column1: 你被關在一間小房間裡，不記得是怎麼來的。走到門前按 E 把門打開。
column2: You're locked in a small room and can't remember how you got here. Walk to the door and press E to open it.

column1: 看著硬幣堆，按左鍵把硬幣抽出來。用手一次只能拿一枚，鏟子會拿得多。
column2: Look at the coin pile and left-click to pull coins out. Your hands take one at a time; a shovel takes more.

column1: 按右鍵把手上的硬幣丟出去。
column2: Right-click to throw the coins in your hands.

column1: 走路時按住 Shift 就能跑，跑得比較快，但會耗體力（左下的黃條）。
column2: Hold Shift while walking to run. It's faster but uses stamina (the yellow bar at the bottom left).

column1: 收購站在遠處的角落。走過去，站在敞開的進料口前，按右鍵把硬幣丟進去，就能拿到錢。
column2: The buyer is in the far corner. Walk over, stand in front of the open hopper and right-click to throw coins in for cash.

column1: 按 Tab 打開科技樹，機器和升級都在這裡買。再按一次 Tab 就能關掉。
column2: Press Tab to open the tech tree — machines and upgrades are bought here. Press Tab again to close it.

column1: 在科技樹花 $0.35 買「抓更大把」，雙手一次可以多抓一枚。
column2: Spend $0.35 in the tech tree on "Bigger handful" so your hands grab one more coin at a time.
Save up for a toy shovel

column1: 一直賣硬幣，賣到連擊條滿。途中再買一級「抓更大把」，連擊條就清得更快。玩具鏟在商店賣 $3.25。
column2: Keep selling coins until the combo bar fills. Buy another level of "Bigger handful" along the way to clear it faster. The toy shovel costs $3.25 at the store.

column1: 五金行是另一個角落的那棟房子（SUPPLY CO.）。走到櫃檯前，按 E 打開商店。
column2: The hardware store is the building in the other corner (SUPPLY CO.). Walk up to the counter and press E to open the store.

column1: 新鏟子已經在手上，放在快捷欄第 2 格，就在徒手旁邊。按 1 把鏟子換回徒手，再按 2 把鏟子拿出來。
column2: Your new shovel is in hotbar slot 2, right next to your bare hands. Press 1 to switch back to your hands, then 2 to take the shovel out again.

column1: 拿著玩具鏟對硬幣堆按左鍵，一次就挖起一整鏟。
column2: Hold the toy shovel up to the pile and left-click to scoop a whole shovelful.

column1: 一直挖，挖到鏟子滿了為止。
column2: Keep digging until the shovel is full.

column1: 對準要放硬幣的地方，按右鍵把整鏟硬幣倒過去，做三次。
column2: Aim where you want the coins and right-click to dump the shovelful there. Do it three times.

column1: 去商店花 $25 買個水桶，裝的比鏟子多很多。
column2: Buy a bucket at the store for $25 — it holds far more than the shovel.

column1: 把水桶放在地上（按 Q），挖硬幣，然後對準水桶按右鍵丟進去。也可以拿著水桶直接挖。裝滿 600 枚。
column2: Put the bucket on the ground (press Q), dig coins, then aim at the bucket and right-click to throw them in. You can also dig straight into it while holding it. Fill it with 600 coins.

column1: 按 E 帶走水桶，提到收購站，站在敞開的進料口前，按住右鍵把硬幣倒進去。
column2: Press E to pick up the bucket, carry it to the buyer, stand at the open hopper and hold right-click to pour the coins in.

column1: 一直賣硬幣，賣到連擊條滿為止，途中買東西不會讓連擊條變慢。圓鍬在商店賣 $30。
column2: Keep selling until the combo bar fills; buying things along the way won't slow it down. The spade costs $30 at the store.

column1: 去商店花 $30 買圓鍬，會放進快捷欄的下一格。
column2: Buy a spade at the store for $30; it goes in the next hotbar slot.

column1: 手上拿著工具，按 Q 放到地上，或按 F 丟出去。工具會留在原地，走過去按 E 就能再撿起來。
column2: While holding a tool, press Q to put it on the ground or F to throw it. It stays where it lands — walk over and press E to pick it up.

column1: 按 Q 把工具放到地上，走到商店櫃檯前按 E，點那件工具旁邊的「送到我這」，工具就會回到你腳邊。
column2: Press Q to put a tool down, go to the store counter and press E, then click "Send to me" next to that tool. It comes back to your feet.

column1: 工具就在你腳邊，走過去按 E 撿起來。
column2: The tool is right at your feet — walk over and press E to pick it up.

column1: 按 B 選一元收藏櫃，這個不用錢，點一下地上的位置就能蓋好。找到的 1 元要放這裡。
column2: Press B and choose the NT$1 collection cabinet. It's free — click a spot on the ground to build it. The NT$1 coins you find go here.

column1: 按 Tab，花 $40 買「輸送帶藍圖」。按 B 選輸送帶，點一下定起點，再點一下定終點。輸送帶上的硬幣會自己往前走。
column2: Press Tab and buy "Conveyor belt blueprint" for $40. Press B, choose the belt, click once for the start and again for the end. Coins on a belt move along by themselves.

column1: 按 B 隨便選一樣東西，滑鼠上就會出現預覽。轉動滑鼠滾輪，或按 C 和 V，預覽就會拉近或推遠。
column2: Press B and pick anything — a preview follows your mouse. Scroll the mouse wheel or press C and V to move it nearer or farther.

column1: 建造的時候按 R，預覽就會轉 90 度。箭頭指的就是硬幣要走的方向。
column2: Press R while building to turn the preview 90°. The arrow shows the way coins will travel.

column1: 建造的時候按 X 切到拆除模式，點一下就拆掉，錢全部退還。
column2: Press X while building to switch to remove mode. Click to remove something and get a full refund.
Connect a belt to the buyer

column1: 按 B 選輸送帶，讓終點落在收購站的進料口，這樣輸送帶上的硬幣就會自己賣掉。
column2: Press B, choose the belt and end it at the buyer's hopper — coins on that belt will sell themselves.

column1: 輸送帶只會往一個方向送硬幣。看著蓋好的輸送帶，上面的箭頭指出往哪走。按住 E 直到箭頭轉過來，輸送帶就反著走，不用花錢。
column2: Belts only carry coins one way; the arrows on a built belt show which. Look at it and hold E until the arrows flip — it runs backwards, free of charge.

column1: 看著一元收藏櫃按滑鼠中鍵，手上就會有一個一模一樣的，可以直接蓋。蓋好的東西都能這樣複製。
column2: Look at the NT$1 collection cabinet and middle-click: you'll be holding an identical one, ready to build. Anything you've built can be copied this way.

column1: 建造的時候按 G，地上會出現方格，看得出建築會對齊哪一格。再按一次 G 就關掉。
column2: Press G while building to show a grid on the ground, so you can see which tile things snap to. Press G again to hide it.

column1: 對準輸送帶按右鍵，把手上的硬幣丟上去，看它自己送到收購站。
column2: Aim at a belt and right-click to throw your coins onto it, then watch them ride to the buyer.

column1: 按 Tab 買「電力」（$30），再按 B 蓋一台硬幣發電機（$160），放些硬幣進去燒（對著它按右鍵）。一台 6kW，3 公尺內的機器直接有電。
column2: Press Tab and buy "Electricity" ($30), then press B to build a coin generator ($160) and feed it coins to burn (right-click it). Each makes 6 kW, and machines within 3 m get power directly.

column1: 按 B 選活塞耙，這台免費，放在硬幣堆前面、面向硬幣堆。後面要保持淨空。
column2: Press B and choose the piston rake — this one's free. Put it in front of the pile, facing it. Keep the back clear.
Power the piston rake with a pole

column1: 在離活塞耙和發電機都不超過 6 公尺的地方放一根電線桿（這根免費），活塞耙就會開始工作。
column2: Put a power pole (this one's free) within 6 m of both the rake and the generator, and the rake starts working.
Set how far the rake throws

column1: 在活塞耙前按 E，選硬幣要丟多遠，讓硬幣落在輸送帶上，或落進地上的水桶或手推車裡。
column2: Press E at the piston rake and choose how far it throws coins, so they land on a belt or in a bucket or wheelbarrow on the ground.

column1: 輸送帶目前很慢。按 Tab 花 $15 買「輸送帶速度提升」第一級，所有輸送帶都會變快，蓋好的也一樣。
column2: Belts are slow for now. Press Tab and spend $15 on level 1 of "Faster belts" — every belt speeds up, including ones already built.

column1: 按 Tab，花 $10 買「小型機械手臂藍圖」。按 B 把手臂放在硬幣堆和輸送帶之間（一支 $100 起），旁邊要有電線桿，手臂會把硬幣放到輸送帶上。
column2: Press Tab and buy "Small robot arm blueprint" for $10. Press B and put an arm between the pile and a belt (from $100), with a power pole nearby. The arm puts coins onto the belt.

column1: 看著電線桿按 E，把整條線路切到關，線上所有機器都會停下，然後再切回開。
column2: Look at a power pole and press E to switch the whole line off — every machine on it stops — then switch it back on.

column1: 按 Tab 解鎖「金屬探測器」，再去商店花 $390 買。離 1 元越近，嗶得越快。在硬幣堆上走一走，仔細聽。
column2: Press Tab to unlock "Metal detector", then buy it at the store for $390. It beeps faster the closer you get to an NT$1 coin. Walk over the pile and listen closely.

column1: 拿著金屬探測器，按左鍵打開。
column2: Hold the metal detector and left-click to turn it on.

column1: 鐵捲門旁的看板上有一張訂單。看著左邊那張大單子按 E，訂單就會出現在螢幕角落。
column2: There's an order on the board by the roller door. Look at the big sheet on the left and press E — the order appears in the corner of the screen.

column1: 這張訂單要在卡車上放二十個硬幣捆。按 Tab 先買「T型分流器」，再花 $150 買「壓縮機藍圖」，按 B 把壓縮機蓋在輸送帶上（$350），旁邊要有電線桿。壓縮機把硬幣壓成捆，賣得比較貴。把硬幣捆送到東牆的出貨口就會裝上卡車。
column2: This order needs twenty coin rolls on the truck. Press Tab and buy "T-splitter", then "Compactor blueprint" for $150, and press B to build a compactor on a belt ($350) with a power pole nearby. Compactors press coins into rolls that sell for more. Send the rolls to the shipping dock on the east wall to load the truck.

column1: 硬幣裡藏著 1 元，跟著賣掉就沒了。按 Tab 花 $100 買「掃描器 Mk I 藍圖」，再按 B 把掃描器放在收購站前面的輸送帶上（一台 $250），掃描器會把 1 元挑出來放進抽屜。
column2: NT$1 coins hide among the others — sell them and they're gone. Press Tab and buy "Scanner Mk I blueprint" for $100, then press B and put a scanner on the belt before the buyer ($250 each). It picks out NT$1 coins and keeps them in its drawer.

column1: 看板上的下一張訂單要十八個包裝硬幣捆。按 Tab 花 $150 買「包裝機藍圖」，按 B 把包裝機蓋在壓縮機後面的輸送帶上（$300），包好的硬幣捆送到卡車上。
column2: The next order on the board wants eighteen wrapped rolls. Press Tab and buy "Wrapper blueprint" for $150, press B and build a wrapper on the belt after the compactor ($300), then send the wrapped rolls to the truck.

column1: 按 Tab 買「運幣無人機藍圖」。按 B 放下停機坪（一架 $200 起），再點一下設定 12 公尺內的放料點，無人機會自己來回搬硬幣。
column2: Press Tab and buy "Coin drone blueprint". Press B to place a landing pad (from $200), then click again to set a drop point within 12 m. The drone ferries coins back and forth by itself.

column1: 按 Tab 買「擴建棚子」，每升一級棚子就會變大。
column2: Press Tab and buy "Expand the shed" — each level makes the shed bigger.

column1: 讓掃描器幫你挑，或用金屬探測器找。挖得越多越容易找到。
column2: Let a scanner pick them out, or hunt with the metal detector. The more you dig, the more likely you'll find one.
Put the NT$1 coin in the cabinet

column1: 走到一元收藏櫃前面按 E，把手上的 1 元放進去。每一種 1 元都有加成。
column2: Walk up to the NT$1 collection cabinet and press E to put the coin in. Every kind of NT$1 coin gives a bonus.

column1: 硬幣堆裡還藏著很多 1 元。把它們全部找出來。
column2: Plenty of NT$1 coins are still hidden in the pile. Find them all.

column1: 教學都做完了，繼續把 1 元找出來吧。
column2: The tutorial is finished — keep hunting for NT$1 coins.

column1: V2.6：電腦版設定多了「極高畫質」：用螢幕原本的解析度，硬幣之間、機器腳邊和牆角多了環境光遮蔽的暗影，畫面更有立體感（很吃效能）。
column2: V2.6: PC settings add "Ultra graphics": native screen resolution plus ambient occlusion shading between coins, at machine feet and in corners for more depth (very demanding).

column1: V2.5：建造目錄多了「裝飾」：盆栽、小花圃、長椅、紅燈籠、招財貓，不用解鎖；坐在長椅上可以休息，體力回得比較快；玩一陣子會有貓跑進院子，可以摸摸牠；晚上偶爾有流星，白天雨停之後會出現彩虹；多了 6 個成就。
column2: V2.5: The build catalog gets "Decor": potted plant, flower bed, bench, red lantern and lucky cat, no unlock needed. Sit on a bench to rest and recover stamina faster. After a while a cat may wander into the yard — you can pet it. Shooting stars at night and rainbows after daytime rain. 6 new achievements.

column1: V2.4：挑戰朋友（挑戰成功後產生連結，朋友打開就是同一座硬幣堆，完成時比較誰快）；每日挑戰記錄連續天數，多兩個連續天數的成就；設定多了字體大小（標準、大、特大）。
column2: V2.4: Challenge a friend (after a challenge, get a link — your friend plays the same pile and you compare times). The daily challenge tracks your streak, with two streak achievements. New text size setting (standard, large, extra large).

column1: V2.3：遊戲出錯時畫面上會跳「點這裡回報」，可以一鍵複製錯誤資訊；「回報問題」也能複製裝置和遊戲資訊、直接到 GitHub 回報；一格畫面出錯不會再讓整個遊戲卡住；設定多了省電模式（每秒 30 格，手機比較不會燙）；打開時會顯示載入中，3D 引擎下載失敗會自動換一個來源，真的載入不了會說明原因。
column2: V2.3: When something goes wrong, a "tap here to report" bar appears and copies the error details in one click. "Report a problem" can also copy device and game info or open a GitHub report. A single bad frame no longer freezes the whole game. New battery saver (30 FPS, keeps phones cooler). A loading screen on start; if the 3D engine fails to download it tries another source and explains what went wrong.

column1: V2.2：每日挑戰（每天一座一樣的硬幣堆，計時找出所有的 1 元，紀錄記在排行榜）；成績分享圖（挑戰成功、挖完硬幣堆、成就與統計都能分享）；手機找到 1 元、完成訂單、買到科技、拿到成就會震動（設定可以關）；網頁版更新了會提示，點一下就換新版。
column2: V2.2: Daily challenge (the same pile for everyone each day — time how fast you find every NT$1 coin, recorded on the leaderboard). Score images to share (after a challenge, clearing the pile, or from achievements & stats). Phones vibrate when you find an NT$1 coin, finish an order, buy tech or earn an achievement (can be turned off). The web version tells you when an update is out — one tap to switch.

column1: V2.1：手機版重做——搖桿按哪裡就出現在哪裡、右下圍成一圈的按鍵、左上工具列、點一下選工具；建造時有架高、降低、方格、復原、藍圖、拉近推遠、取消，看著建築可以複製，建造目錄長按加到快捷欄；教學和提示改成按鈕說法；所有面板改成手機專用排法（科技樹左邊分類、中間小卡片，多一個「買得起」分類；建造目錄一次看得到三排；機器設定從下方拉出；設定兩欄、暫停大按鈕）；進遊戲自動全螢幕並鎖橫向，可以加入主畫面；加入主畫面後沒網路也能玩；拍照和匯出存檔在手機上改用分享選單（存到相簿、存到檔案、傳 LINE），多了存檔碼，複製貼上就能把存檔搬到別台裝置。雙手和所有工具照真實比例重做，有挖、丟、倒、掃的動作；走到機器上不會再卡住；水桶不會破圖。
column2: V2.1: Rebuilt phone version — the joystick appears where you touch, action buttons ring the bottom right, a toolbar sits top left and tools are one tap away. Building adds raise, lower, grid, undo, blueprint, zoom and cancel; copy what you look at; long-press in the catalog to add to the hotbar. Tutorial and tips use button names. Every panel has a phone layout. Fullscreen and landscape lock on start, add to home screen, play offline. Photos and save exports use the share sheet, plus save codes to move saves between devices. Hands and tools remade at real scale with dig, throw, pour and sweep animations; no more getting stuck on machines; the bucket no longer glitches.

column1: V2：數值改成原作（遊戲資料）；24 種 1 元；第五種尺寸 The Mountain；體力、灑出來、蹲著走、噴射背包；壓縮機、包裝機、造粒機、圓盤壓製機、紙漿機、造紙機、筒倉、燃氣發電廠；抽水機和水管；T 型接頭、閘門、封閉式輸送帶、分流器優先、手臂連輸送帶；地下電纜箱、開關箱、用電警示；衛星天線、精準定位；平台、樓梯、欄杆、牆、屋頂、升降機、架高輸送帶；工作燈、油漆板；訂單時間限制；音效和背景音樂；教學照原作改成 46 步。
column2: V2: Numbers match the original game data; 24 kinds of NT$1 coins; a fifth size, The Mountain; stamina, spilling, crouch-walking, jetpack; compactor, wrapper, pelletizer, disc press, pulper, paper machine, silo, gas power plant; pumps and pipes; T-junctions, gates, covered belts, splitter priority, belt-linked arms; underground cable boxes, switch box, power warnings; satellite dish, precision mode; platforms, stairs, railings, walls, roofs, lifts, raised belts; work lights, paint boards; order time limits; sound effects and music; a 46-step tutorial like the original.

column2: Last night, the co-op's truck dumped a whole mountain of loose change here.

column1: V3.0：新的劇情《第一枚一元》：信箱會收到鎮上的人寄來的信，硬幣山裡會挖到阿公留下的東西，最後在院子辦一場一元展、放天燈（一般和無盡模式，設定裡可以關掉）。收藏櫃改成可以點開來轉著看每一枚 1 元，還有每一枚的主人說的話；放大鏡鑑定改成用放大鏡找出 3 個特徵，重複的 1 元不再打斷你。
column2: V3.0: A new story, “The First NT$1”: the townsfolk send you letters, Grandpa's keepsakes turn up in the coin mountain, and it ends with an NT$1 Show and sky lanterns in your yard (Normal and Endless modes; you can turn it off in Settings). In the collection cabinet you can now open each NT$1 and spin it, with a note from its owner. The magnifier appraisal now has you find 3 features, and duplicate NT$1 coins no longer interrupt you.

column1: 你好，我是海口信用合作社的黃理事長。昨天晚上卡車倒東西的聲音，應該把你吵醒了吧，真不好意思。
column2: Hello, I'm Chairman Huang of the Haikou Credit Cooperative. The truck dumping its load last night must have woken you up. I'm so sorry about that.

column1: 合作社月底就要收了，金庫裡存了五十年的零錢，實在不知道該放哪裡。後來我們在你阿公的抽屜裡找到一張紙條，上面寫著：「金庫的錢，交給我孫子整理。」所以就全部倒在你家院子了。
column2: The co-op closes at the end of the month, and we had no idea where to put fifty years of loose change from the vault. Then we found a note in your grandpa's drawer: “Give the money in the vault to my grandchild to sort out.” So we dumped all of it in your yard.

column1: 你阿公在合作社當了四十年的出納。鎮上的孩子第一次來開戶，存的都是一枚 1 元，他會在存摺上蓋第一個章，再把那枚 1 元收進金庫。那些「第一枚一元」，現在全都混在這座山裡。
column2: Your grandpa was the co-op's teller for forty years. When the town's children opened their first account, each of them deposited a single NT$1. He'd stamp the first mark in their passbook and put that coin in the vault. All those “first NT$1 coins” are mixed into this mountain now.

column1: 硬幣賣掉的錢都歸你，工具可以去五金行找阿德買。只拜託你一件事：裡面的 1 元，請一枚一枚找出來，放進收藏櫃。鎮上的人都很想再看看自己的第一枚。
column2: The money from selling the coins is yours, and you can buy tools from Ah-De at the hardware store. I only ask one thing: please find the NT$1 coins, one by one, and put them in the collection cabinet. Everyone in town would love to see their first coin again.

column1: 海口信用合作社　黃理事長
阿德跟我說，你找到第一枚了！
column2: Ah-De told me you found your first one!

column1: 你阿公以前常常坐在我店門口喝彈珠汽水，順便幫我數零錢。他數錢的時候好認真，眼鏡都滑到鼻頭了也不知道。
column2: Your grandpa used to sit outside my shop drinking marble soda and helping me count change. He took counting so seriously that his glasses would slide to the tip of his nose without him noticing.

column1: 我的第一枚一元是凹的。那天我把它放在門口的台階上，被我弟弟的腳踏車壓過去，我哭了一整個下午。你阿公蹲下來跟我說：「凹的也是一元啊，一樣可以存。」
column2: My first NT$1 was bent. I'd left it on the step outside the shop, and my little brother rode his bike right over it. I cried all afternoon. Your grandpa crouched down and told me, “A bent one is still a dollar. You can still save it.”

column1: 如果你找到一枚凹凹的一元，說不定就是我的。找到的話，要讓我看看喔。
column2: If you find a bent NT$1, it might be mine. If you do, let me see it, okay?

column1: 肚子餓了就過來，阿嬤請你吃枝仔冰。
column2: Come by if you get hungry. Grandma will treat you to a popsicle.

column1: 隔壁柑仔店　秀蘭阿嬤
column2: Grandma Hsiu-lan, from the corner shop next door

column1: 聽到你院子裡的機器聲了，很好聽！
column2: I can hear the machines in your yard. Sounds great!

column1: 你阿公是我店裡最會殺價的客人，買一包螺絲可以講二十分鐘，最後還要我多送兩顆。不過他修東西真的厲害，合作社那台老算錢機，他修了三十年都沒換。
column2: Your grandpa was the best haggler I ever had. He could spend twenty minutes on one bag of screws and still talk me into two extra. But he really could fix anything. He kept the co-op's old counting machine running for thirty years.

column1: 他走之前，在我店裡寄放了一台舊收音機，說等孫子回來再交給你。我已經幫你放進建造目錄的「裝飾」了，不用錢。
column2: Before he passed, he left an old radio with me and said to give it to his grandchild when you came home. I've put it in the “Decor” section of your Build catalog. It's free.

column1: 放在院子裡，走過去按 E 就能打開。他以前最喜歡一邊修東西、一邊聽老歌。
column2: Put it in the yard, then walk up and press E to turn it on. He loved listening to old songs while he fixed things.

column1: SUPPLY CO. 五金行　阿德
我是開卡車的阿財啦！訂單的貨都是我來載。
column2: It's Ah-Tsai, the truck driver! I'm the one who hauls your orders.

column1: 偷偷跟你說，你不要跟理事長講：第一天晚上我倒錯位置了，本來要倒在院子中間偏左一點……算了，反正都在院子裡。
column2: Between you and me (don't tell the chairman): I dumped it in the wrong spot that first night. It was supposed to go a little left of the middle of the yard… eh, it's in the yard either way.

column1: 你做的硬幣捆很漂亮，整整齊齊的。我載去城裡，人家都問是哪裡做的，我就說：海口庄啊！
column2: Your coin rolls look great, neat and tidy. When I drive them into the city, people ask where they're from, and I tell them: Haikou Village!

column1: 以後我出發的時候，會按喇叭跟你說再見。叭叭！
column2: From now on I'll honk goodbye whenever I head out. Beep beep!

column1: 阿德說你在硬幣堆裡挖到一副眼鏡。我一看就知道，那是你阿公的！右邊的鏡腳是他自己用鐵絲綁的，綁了十幾年都捨不得換。
column2: Ah-De says you dug up a pair of glasses in the coin pile. I knew right away they were your grandpa's! He tied the right arm together with wire himself, and he wouldn't replace them for more than ten years.

column1: 他總說戴著這副眼鏡，才看得清楚每一枚一元的年份。有一次他找眼鏡找了一整個下午，結果眼鏡就掛在他頭上。
column2: He always said he needed those glasses to read the year on every NT$1. Once he spent a whole afternoon looking for them, and they were on top of his head the entire time.

column1: 放在收藏櫃裡吧，讓它繼續陪著那些一元。
column2: Keep them in the collection cabinet, so they can keep those coins company.

column1: 你挖到的那本，是合作社最早的「第一枚登記簿」！我們找了好多年。
column2: The book you dug up is the co-op's very first “First-Coin Register”! We've been looking for it for years.

column1: 每個孩子存第一枚一元的那天，你阿公都會在上面寫下名字和日期。我的名字在第三頁，民國六十四年，那年我六歲。
column2: On the day each child deposited their first NT$1, your grandpa wrote their name and the date in it. Mine is on page three, in 1975, when I was six.

column1: 最後一頁有一行字，是你阿公的筆跡，寫的是你的名字，旁邊註明：「乖孫的第一枚，先放在我這裡。」
column2: On the last page there's a line in your grandpa's handwriting. It's your name, and next to it he wrote: “My grandchild's first coin. I'll keep it for now.”

column1: 所以，你的第一枚一元，應該也在這座山的某個地方。
column2: So your first NT$1 must be somewhere in this mountain too.

column1: 為了謝謝你，合作社的舊招牌就送給你了，已經放進建造目錄的「裝飾」。掛了五十年，跟我差不多老呢。
column2: As thanks, the co-op's old sign is yours. It's in the “Decor” section of your Build catalog. It hung there for fifty years, so it's almost as old as I am!

column1: 你挖到的那張照片，阿德拿來給我看了。我看了好久好久。
column2: Ah-De brought me the photo you dug up. I looked at it for a long, long time.

column1: 照片裡綁辮子的女孩是我，旁邊穿工作服的，是陳師傅。那年他剛去造幣廠當學徒，每次回鎮上，都會繞到我店裡買一瓶彈珠汽水。
column2: The girl with the braids is me, and the young man in work clothes is Master Chen. That year he'd just become an apprentice at the mint, and whenever he came back to town he'd stop by my shop for a bottle of marble soda.

column1: 他說過，總有一天要送我一枚「世界上獨一無二的一元」。後來他調到外地，就再也沒有回來了。
column2: He once said that someday he'd give me “the only NT$1 like it in the whole world.” Then he was transferred away and never came back.

column1: 我寫了一封信寄去他以前的地址，也不知道他還住不住在那裡。如果有回信，我再告訴你。
column2: I've written to his old address, though I don't know if he still lives there. If he writes back, I'll let you know.

column1: 我是陳師傅。秀蘭的信，我收到了，讀了三遍。
column2: This is Master Chen. I got Hsiu-lan's letter and read it three times.

column1: 那張照片，我也有一張，一直放在皮夾裡。
column2: I have a copy of that photo too. It's been in my wallet all these years.

column1: 說起來不好意思。年輕時，我用造幣廠試鑄的模具，偷偷打了一枚一元，自己鍍上一層金，想送給秀蘭。可是走到柑仔店門口，就是不敢進去。最後我把它存進合作社，請你阿公幫我保管，說等我有勇氣了再去拿。
column2: It's embarrassing to admit. When I was young, I used a trial die at the mint to secretly strike an NT$1, and plated it in gold myself to give to Hsiu-lan. But when I reached the door of her shop, I couldn't bring myself to go in. In the end I deposited it at the co-op and asked your grandpa to keep it safe until I found the courage to come for it.

column1: 秀蘭說，那枚金色的一元，你已經找到了。謝謝你。
column2: Hsiu-lan says you've already found that golden NT$1. Thank you.

column1: 那枚金色的一元，應該還在你院子的硬幣山裡。如果你找到了，可以幫我放進收藏櫃嗎？不急，慢慢找。
column2: That golden NT$1 should still be somewhere in the coin mountain in your yard. If you find it, would you put it in the collection cabinet for me? No rush. Take your time.

column1: 下次回海口庄，我想去你的院子坐坐。
column2: Next time I'm back in Haikou, I'd like to come sit in your yard for a while.

column1: 陳師傅回來了！他說想看看那枚金色的一元，也想看看你阿公的院子。
column2: Master Chen is back! He wants to see the golden NT$1, and your grandpa's yard too.

column1: 他還是跟以前一樣，講沒兩句話就臉紅。
column2: He's just like he used to be: two sentences in and he's blushing.

column1: 我們找一個晚上，去你院子的長椅坐坐，不會吵到你的。
column2: One of these evenings we'll come sit on the bench in your yard. We won't get in your way.

column1: 你的院子如果有一張長椅就好了，我們老人家站不久。（建造目錄的「裝飾」裡有長椅）
column2: If only your yard had a bench. Us old folks can't stand for long. (There's a bench in the “Decor” section of the Build catalog.)

column1: 你看到這封信的時候，院子應該亂得不像話吧。
column2: By the time you read this, the yard must be an unbelievable mess.

column1: 這五十年，鎮上每個孩子的第一枚一元，都是我收的。我一直想讓大家再看一次，可是年紀大了，數不動了，只好交給你。
column2: For fifty years, I took in every child's first NT$1 in this town. I always wanted everyone to see them again, but I'm old now and can't count them anymore. So I'm leaving it to you.

column1: 盒子裡那枚，是你的第一枚一元。那年你才三歲，握在手裡不肯放，最後是用一顆糖跟你換的。
column2: The one in this box is your first NT$1. You were only three. You held on to it and wouldn't let go, so I traded you a piece of candy for it.

column1: 另外那枚金色的，是陳師傅寄放的。他來拿的時候，幫我跟他說一句：她一直在等。
column2: The golden one beside it belongs to Master Chen. When he comes for it, tell him something for me: she's been waiting.

column1: 山裡那枚金色的一元，是陳師傅寄放在我這裡的。如果他回來了，幫我跟他說一句：她一直在等。
column2: The golden NT$1 in the mountain is one Master Chen left with me. If he ever comes back, tell him something for me: she's been waiting.

column1: 慢慢挖，不用急。累了就坐下來，摸摸貓，看看天空。
column2: Dig slowly, no need to hurry. When you're tired, sit down, pet the cat, look at the sky.

column1: 錢是拿來用的，可是有些一元，是拿來記得的。
column2: Money is for spending. But some coins are for remembering.

column1: 謝謝你，把整座山都整理好了。
column2: Thank you for sorting out the whole mountain.

column1: 鎮上的人聽說了，都想來看看自己的第一枚。今天晚上，可以在你的院子辦一場「一元展」嗎？
column2: Word got around town, and everyone wants to come see their first coin. Could we hold an “NT$1 Show” in your yard tonight?

column1: 大家會帶天燈來。阿財說他負責載椅子，秀蘭阿嬤負責枝仔冰。
column2: Everyone will bring sky lanterns. Ah-Tsai says he'll bring chairs in his truck, and Grandma Hsiu-lan is in charge of popsicles.

column1: 昨天晚上的天燈好漂亮，我跟陳師傅看到最後一盞飛不見了才回家。
column2: Last night's sky lanterns were so beautiful. Master Chen and I didn't go home until the last one had disappeared.
I'm sure your grandpa saw them too.

column1: 院子整理好了，可是不用急著走喔。有空就來柑仔店坐坐，彈珠汽水阿嬤請。
column2: The yard is all tidy now, but don't feel you have to leave. Come sit at the shop anytime. The marble soda's on Grandma.

column1: 被我弟弟的腳踏車壓過，我哭了一整個下午。你阿公說：凹的也是一元啊。
column2: My little brother rode his bike over it and I cried all afternoon. Your grandpa said a bent one is still a dollar.
Uncle Shui, the tofu pudding seller

column1: 推車賣了四十年豆花，找零找到字都磨不見了。
column2: Forty years selling tofu pudding from a cart. I gave it out as change until the lettering wore off.

column1: 我第一次自己去存錢，櫃檯的阿公還送我一顆糖。
column2: The first time I went to save money by myself, the grandpa at the counter gave me a candy.

column1: 跟鑰匙、螺絲放在同一個口袋，刮成這樣很正常啦。
column2: It shared a pocket with keys and screws. Of course it's scratched.

column1: 這是我出嫁前存的。那時候的一元，可以買好多顆糖。
column2: I saved this before I got married. Back then, a dollar bought a lot of candy.

column1: 掉進廟口的水溝好幾年，撈起來就長滿銅綠了。
column2: It sat in the gutter outside the temple for years. When I fished it out, it was covered in verdigris.

column1: 小時候拿去磨，想把它磨成金的，結果磨成紅的。
column2: As a kid I polished it, hoping to turn it into gold. It turned red instead.

column1: 我都跟學生說，梅花特別清楚的那枚，是幸運的一元。
column2: I always tell my students the one with the clearest plum blossom is the lucky one.

column1: 中秋節烤肉，它掉進炭火裡，第二天才撿出來。
column2: It fell into the coals at a Mid-Autumn barbecue. I didn't fish it out until the next day.

column1: 穿個洞綁在船頭，出海四十年，一次都沒翻船。
column2: I punched a hole in it and tied it to my bow. Forty years at sea, and I never capsized once.

column1: 放在剪刀盒裡太久，變得黑亮黑亮的，可以照鏡子。
column2: It sat in my scissor case so long it turned glossy black. You can see yourself in it.

column1: 這是我的魔術道具！猜正反面，我從來沒輸過。
column2: This is my magic prop! I've never lost a coin toss.

column1: 顏色這麼純的銅，我做了一輩子銅器也很少看到。
column2: A lifetime of coppersmithing, and I've rarely seen copper this pure.

column1: V3.1：一元展之後，黃理事長會送你「一元博物館」：找到的每一種 1 元都會擺進玻璃展示櫃，晚上偶爾有鎮上的人來看；照真實的日期，過年院子會貼春聯、放煙火、收到紅包，中秋有大月亮、烤肉架和柚子；阿公的收音機可以換台（三首老歌、雨聲和蟲鳴）；拍的照片會收進新的「相簿」，主選單和暫停選單都打得開。
column2: V3.1: After the NT$1 Show, Chairman Huang gives you the “NT$1 Museum”: every kind of NT$1 you find goes into a glass display case, and townsfolk sometimes come by at night to see it. Following the real calendar, Lunar New Year brings spring couplets, fireworks and a red envelope, and Mid-Autumn brings a big moon, a barbecue grill and pomelos. Grandpa's radio now has stations (three old songs, plus rain and crickets). Your photos also go into a new Album, which you can open from the main menu or the pause menu.

column1: V3.2：硬幣會滑落了：挖得太陡（像懸崖）的地方，邊上的硬幣會沿著坡滑下來、叮叮噹噹地補進洞裡，滑到不陡就停，整座山的形狀不會變；The Mountain 挖出來的斷崖也會慢慢塌下來，不再一下子削平。
column2: V3.2: Coins now slide. Where you dig too steeply, like a cliff, the coins at the edge slide down and clink into the hole, stopping once it is no longer steep, so the pile keeps its overall shape. On The Mountain, cliffs you dig now crumble gradually instead of flattening all at once.
